title: Arkansas Acts 2024 (2nd Ex. Sess.), Act 1 (SB 1): reduction of income taxes; amends Ark. Code 26-51-201(a)(3)
citation: Acts 2024 (2nd Ex. Sess.), No. 1, s 1 (Ark. Code 26-51-201(a)(3))
why_session_law: The Arkansas Code itself is published only through LexisNexis's Code of Arkansas Public Access, which served a CAPTCHA on 2026-09-23 (a no). The General Assembly publishes the Acts themselves; this Act sets out the amended subdivision in full.
currency: The Bureau of Legislative Research's 'Code Sections Amended' lists for the 2025 Regular Session and the 2026 Fiscal Session (read 2026-10-24) show no later amendment of 26-51-201(a)(3). The rest of s 26-51-201 is not deposited.
